high.title: Signs of Short-term Peak Formation in VN-Index
high.summary: The market has closed April 2026 - the peak period for enterprises holding annual shareholder meetings, announcing 2026 business plans and Q1 results. SHS Securities notes that entering May, the market will receive important macroeconomic data for April including inflation, import-export, PMI to reflect the impact of Middle East conflicts on businesses and the economy. May markets will be influenced by both risk and positive factors. Risk factors include: prolonged geopolitical tensions entering new phases; declining credit growth; energy crisis with rising inflation and input cost pressures beginning to clearly impact businesses and the economy; and high margin lending debt levels in the market. This analysis is crucial for VN-Index direction and investor sentiment assessment.

high.title: Many Large Private Banks Experience Deposit Declines of Tens of Trillions of Dong in Q1
high.summary: 12 out of 27 listed banks recorded deposit declines in Q1/2026, with total customer deposits reaching over 12.88 million billion VND, up only 0.6% vs end-2025. BIDV led declines with 82.031 trillion VND decrease (-3.7%) to 2.14 million billion VND, while MB saw deposits fall 15.450 trillion VND (-1.7%) to 905.918 billion VND. Major private banks including Techcombank, VPBank, and others also experienced significant deposit outflows. This deposit flight indicates potential liquidity pressures in the banking system and could signal tighter monetary conditions affecting lending capacity and interest rates - critical factors for VND stability and government bond demand.

medium.title: Dividend Rights Cut-off Schedule 11-15/5: 50 Enterprises Simultaneously "Rolling Cut-off", Hoa Phat Participates, One Bank Pays Nearly 9,000 Billion in Dividends
medium.summary: LPBank will cut dividend rights on May 15 for 2025 cash dividend at 30% rate, requiring 8,962 billion VND payout. This represents the highest cash dividend rate in the banking system for 2026, supporting banking sector attractiveness and potential capital outflows from government bonds to equities.

medium.title: Bank with Highest 2026 Cash Dividend Rate Will Roll Cut-off Next Week
medium.summary: LPBank confirms 30% cash dividend rate (3,000 VND per share), making it the highest cash dividend rate in the banking system for 2026. The bank will maintain pure cash dividend policy with large scale, potentially affecting money market flows and investor preferences between bank stocks and government bonds.

medium.title: Which Bank Has the Most Group 5 Bad Debt?
medium.summary: Total Group 5 debt across 27 listed banks reached 168.543 trillion VND as of March 31, 2026, up 535 billion VND vs end-2025. Sacombank tops with 30.547 trillion VND, becoming the first Vietnamese bank to exceed 30,000 billion VND in Group 5 debt. Rising bad debt levels could pressure banking sector stability and credit growth prospects.

medium.title: Positive Information Series Emerges, Will VN-Index Soon Conquer 2,000 Points?
medium.summary: ABS Securities reports positive outlook for Vietnamese stock market with VN-Index successfully creating bottom support at 1,586-1,606 points. Strong buying momentum observed in major sectors including banking, real estate, securities, steel, and transportation. Money flow beginning to spread to mid and small-cap stocks signals broader market recovery beyond blue chips.
